title: Kim Jong Un Isn’t Returning Trump’s Calls
title_zh: 金正恩不回川普的電話
subtitle: 金正恩不回川普的電話
author: Emma Tucker

sentences.en: With so much attention focused on conflicts elsewhere, North Korea’s growing nuclear threat has largely slipped out of the spotlight.
sentences.zh: 眾人的目光都放在其他衝突上，北韓日益增大的核威脅，幾乎已淡出焦點。

sentences.en: On Friday, we reported that new satellite images show an expansion of a North Korean uranium-enrichment plant.
sentences.zh: 週五我們報導，新的衛星影像顯示，北韓一座鈾濃縮廠正在擴建。

sentences.en: Since Kim Jong Un last met President Trump in 2019, his nuclear arsenal has grown to an estimated 60 warheads.
sentences.zh: 自金正恩 2019 年最後一次與川普總統會面以來，他的核武庫已增至估計 60 枚彈頭。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Trump’s hopes of reconnecting have gone unrealized.
sentences.zh: 與此同時，川普想重新建立聯繫的希望一直沒有實現。

sentences.en: Today, our reporters explain how Kim has strengthened his position through closer ties with Russia, massive cryptocurrency thefts and a growing nuclear stockpile—all while resisting Trump’s overtures.
sentences.zh: 今天，本報記者解釋金正恩如何藉由拉近與俄羅斯的關係、大規模加密貨幣竊盜，以及不斷擴大的核儲備來鞏固自身地位，同時拒絕川普的示好。

sentences.en: The United Arab Emirates is shuttling oil through the Strait of Hormuz with U.S. military protection, braving Iranian attacks to keep crude flowing and help break Tehran’s grip on the waterway.
sentences.zh: 阿拉伯聯合大公國在美軍保護下，經荷莫茲海峽運送石油，冒著伊朗攻擊的風險，以維持原油流動，並設法打破德黑蘭對這條水道的掌控。

sentences.en: The AI selloff ravaging the stock market in recent weeks is remarkably like the bursting of the dot-com bubble, writes James Mackintosh.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯・麥金塔寫道，近幾週肆虐股市的 AI 拋售，與網路泡沫破裂驚人地相似。

sentences.en: A new figure emerges in the Nvidia chip-smuggling saga.
sentences.zh: 輝達晶片走私事件又出現了一個新角色。

sentences.en: Alice Huang, the romantic partner of ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, was the public face of Megaspeed, a Singapore company suspected of funneling advanced computing power to China.
sentences.zh: 被趕下台的輝達執行長黃仁勳的伴侶 Alice Huang，是新加坡公司 Megaspeed 的對外代表；該公司涉嫌把先進算力輸送到中國。

sentences.en: But behind the scenes was Li Ming, a 52-year-old Chinese national now facing fraud charges in Singapore.
sentences.zh: 但在幕後的是李明，這位 52 歲的中國籍人士目前在新加坡面臨詐欺指控。

sentences.en: Stu Woo uncovers the previously unreported connections behind a scandal that brought down one of Silicon Valley’s biggest names.
sentences.zh: 吳斯圖揭開這樁醜聞背後先前未報導的關聯；這樁醜聞讓矽谷一個最響亮的名字垮台。

vocab.usage: slip out of the spotlight 淡出焦點；in the spotlight 處於焦點之中
vocab.example: The issue slipped out of the spotlight after the election.
vocab.example_zh: 這個議題在選舉之後就淡出了焦點。

vocab.usage: uranium-enrichment 鈾濃縮；job enrichment 工作充實；enrich 是動詞
vocab.example: The plant is used for uranium enrichment.
vocab.example_zh: 這座工廠用於鈾濃縮。

vocab.usage: a nuclear arsenal 核武庫；an arsenal of tools 一大批工具（引申）
vocab.example: The country is expanding its nuclear arsenal.
vocab.example_zh: 這個國家正在擴充核武庫。

vocab.usage: hopes have gone unrealized 希望未能實現；unrealized gains 未實現獲利（會計用語）
vocab.example: His plan to expand overseas remains unrealized.
vocab.example_zh: 他海外擴張的計畫仍未實現。

vocab.usage: a nuclear stockpile 核儲備；stockpile supplies 囤積物資（也可當動詞）
vocab.example: Hospitals are building a stockpile of emergency medicines.
vocab.example_zh: 醫院正在建立緊急藥品儲備。

vocab.usage: resist someone’s overtures 拒絕某人的示好；peace overtures 和平提議；常用複數
vocab.example: The union rejected the company’s overtures for early talks.
vocab.example_zh: 工會拒絕了公司提前談判的示好。

vocab.usage: shuttle oil through the strait 經海峽往返運油；名詞 shuttle 是「接駁、太空梭」
vocab.example: Buses shuttle workers between the station and the factory.
vocab.example_zh: 巴士在車站和工廠之間往返接送工人。

vocab.usage: braving Iranian attacks 冒著伊朗攻擊的風險；brave the storm 冒著暴風雨；形容詞 brave 是「勇敢的」
vocab.example: Thousands braved the rain to vote.
vocab.example_zh: 數千人冒著雨去投票。

vocab.usage: break Tehran’s grip on the waterway 打破德黑蘭對水道的掌控；in the grip of 處於…之中
vocab.example: The company tightened its grip on the supply chain.
vocab.example_zh: 這家公司加強了對供應鏈的掌控。

vocab.usage: the selloff ravaging the stock market 肆虐股市的拋售；a storm ravaged the coast 暴風雨肆虐海岸
vocab.example: Wildfires ravaged the northern forests last summer.
vocab.example_zh: 去年夏天，野火肆虐了北部森林。

vocab.usage: the bursting of the dot-com bubble 網路泡沫破裂；a housing bubble 房市泡沫
vocab.example: Many investors lost money when the bubble burst.
vocab.example_zh: 泡沫破裂時，許多投資人虧了錢。

vocab.usage: the chip-smuggling saga 晶片走私事件的來龍去脈；a legal saga 漫長的法律糾紛
vocab.example: The merger saga lasted almost two years.
vocab.example_zh: 這樁併購風波持續了將近兩年。

vocab.usage: the ousted CEO 被撤職的執行長；動詞 oust 是「趕走、撤職」
vocab.example: The ousted mayor still has many supporters.
vocab.example_zh: 這位被趕下台的市長仍有許多支持者。

vocab.usage: funnel computing power to China 把算力輸送到中國；funnel money into 把錢投入；名詞 funnel 是「漏斗」
vocab.example: Donors funneled millions into the campaign.
vocab.example_zh: 捐款人把數百萬美元輸送到這場競選活動。

vocab.usage: behind the scenes was… 在幕後的是…；work behind the scenes 在幕後運作
vocab.example: A small team worked behind the scenes to close the deal.
vocab.example_zh: 一個小組在幕後努力促成這筆交易。

vocab.usage: uncover connections / a scandal 揭開關聯／醜聞
vocab.example: The audit uncovered errors in the accounts.
vocab.example_zh: 這次稽核揭開了帳目中的錯誤。

vocab.usage: collective wealth 合計財富；collective effort 集體努力
vocab.example: Their collective experience helped the team finish early.
vocab.example_zh: 他們合計的經驗，讓團隊提前完成工作。

vocab.usage: preliminary readings / results 初值／初步結果；preliminary talks 初步會談
vocab.example: Preliminary results show a slight increase in sales.
vocab.example_zh: 初步結果顯示銷售略有增加。

vocab.usage: the Fed’s preferred inflation gauge 聯準會偏好的通膨指標；動詞 gauge 是「評估、測量」
vocab.example: Retail sales are a useful gauge of consumer demand.
vocab.example_zh: 零售銷售是衡量消費需求的有用指標。

vocab.usage: the personal-consumption expenditures price index 個人消費支出物價指數；Fed 最看重的通膨指標
vocab.example: Markets are waiting for the personal-consumption expenditures data.
vocab.example_zh: 市場正在等待個人消費支出數據。
